definitions.gloss: rear-end collision; running into the back of another vehicle
definitions.explanation: A traffic accident where one vehicle crashes into the back of the vehicle ahead of it. One of the most common types of traffic accidents.

examples.japanese: {信号待|しんごうま}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追突|ついとつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was rear-ended while waiting at a traffic light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{追突|ついとつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A rear-end collision occurred on the expressway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車間距離|しゃかんきょり}→車間距離：14858_shakankyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}らない→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{追突|ついとつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't maintain enough distance between cars, there is a risk of a rear-end collision.

notes:
USAGE:
A common term in traffic news and accident reports. The driver who rear-ends another vehicle is typically considered at fault in Japan. Chain rear-end collisions ({玉突|たまつ}き⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧) involving multiple vehicles are also discussed using this term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追突|ついとつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (rear-end collision accident)
- {追突|ついとつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rear-end)
- {追突|ついとつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be rear-ended)
- {追突|ついとつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent a rear-end collision)
